summary: The PR addresses the issue of decoding session data during the transition to Django 3.1 by using the legacy encoding format when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1'. However, it introduces some style inconsistencies and could benefit from additional documentation.

issues.description: The code uses a mix of single and double quotes, which is inconsistent with the rest of the Django codebase. It should use double quotes consistently.
The change lacks a comment explaining why the legacy encoding format is used when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1'. Adding a comment would improve code readability and maintainability.
